cases.name: Brandi Delia Hayes Goolsby
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Brandi was a 2006 graduate of Dalton L. McMichael High School, where she was a member of the basketball and track teams. She went on to further her education and obtained her bachelor’s degree from Johnson C. Smith University.

Brandi had a contagious smile, a bubbly personality, and a presence that left an impact on all who knew her. She always strived to be better, and do more for herself, her community, and the ones closest to her. From being an author, starting her own fitness brand, and being a member of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, she had many accomplishments. The thing she was most proud of was being Noelle’s mom."

cases.name: Simone Octavia Williams
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Simone attended Cabarrus County Schools, then later transferred to Charlotte-Mecklenburg, and graduated from Rocky River High School in 2015. Simone continued her education at Western Carolina University, where she earned a degree in Psychology while participating in track and field. Afterward, Simone worked in the Rutherford County Department of Social Services, and later continued her career at the Cabarrus County Department of Social Services. During this time, she decided to pursue an advanced degree from Wake Forest University, where she earned her Master’s degree in Counseling in August of 2023. After earning her Master’s degree, as a person who continually pursued excellence in her career, Simone obtained her license as a Clinical Mental Health Counselor while working with the Iredell Health System."
